The machine has a yellow mold section with multiple rectangular cavities, and red vibrators are visible above it.
A sticker on the red frame reads 'OLA TECH METAL' with a logo and images of people.

The machine appears to be a manual or semi-automatic concrete block molding machine, likely operated by pressing down on the handle to compact the concrete in the mold.
